subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced as the speaker who initiated the investigation into Janussi's chambers and recognized the significance of the wrapping paper trail from the poisoned book.
source_quote: We had three problems and roughly the same number of people willing to go chase them. The third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers was still unvisited. We knew the wrapping paper from the poisoned book had been taken there, and we hadn't gone back.

subject: third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers
fact: The third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers contained a note written by Janussi that dismissed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal as solipsism and revealed his contempt for criminal investigation methodologies.
source_quote: There was a note. 'Oh, a note! I read it.' The opening line landed like a thrown stone. 'Oh boy, this starts out with some real academic insult.' ... Janussi had reviewed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal for new criminal investigation methodologies, found it to be solipsism, and had blocked it.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch is the First Reader whose criminal investigation methodology, the Threefold Proof, was formally rejected by Janussi and later used by Kalan as the basis for his own investigative authority.
source_quote: Janussi had reviewed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal for new criminal investigation methodologies, found it to be solipsism, and had blocked it. ... Kalan's entire proposal for dealing with crime, the Threefold Proof, the methodologies, the framework we'd been handed as a legitimate investigation tool, had been blocked by the man who was now dead.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is a dragonborn who allegedly burned something at the feast, an action referenced as a critical point of inquiry for the investigation.
source_quote: When you talk to Alkrist, there's something in the list about what Alkrist burned at the feast — you should ask about that.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira is a tiefling researcher framed for Janussi's murder, suffering from a fevered illness while under investigation, and revealed she was the target of prejudice due to her infernal research and relationship with Janussi.
source_quote: Sylvira was framed for the murder and dying slowly under the poison's effect. ... Her area of research was the infernal domains, which compounded the prejudice. The relationship with Janussi had probably offended someone else on top of that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the drow investigator who conducted the interview with Sylvira, recognized her framing as deliberate, and elicited her testimony about suspects including Kazryn Nyantani and Daral Yashenti.
source_quote: I said it without ceremony. I had questions that needed her full cognitive engagement. ... I asked whether she had any ideas about who might want to frame her... Daral Yashenti came up first... Then: Kazryn Nyantani.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is the investigator who ascended to the third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers, discovered Janussi's note, and identified its devastating impact on Kalan Strongbranch's professional credibility.
source_quote: I poked around... There was a note. 'Oh, a note! I read it.' ... I had to read that sentence twice. ... That doesn't make him a murderer. But it means he built his whole methodology in the wreckage of the man who told him he was wrong.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris is the investigator who pursued Kalan Strongbranch, recognizing his absence as critical to resolving the Alkrist interview and the broader investigation.
source_quote: I'm gonna have to hunt Kalan down," he said, the energy of a man who locates missing First Readers as a matter of routine. ... "Let me go, let me go." He paused at the threshold... "At some point I'll return with Kalan.

subject: Sylvira's quarters
fact: Sylvira's quarters contained a magically operated faux fireplace, a familiar named Jezebel, and signs of forced endurance despite severe illness, indicating her active resistance to incapacitation.
source_quote: A mage hand, which was interesting: she was bedridden and shuddering under a fever, and still running a familiar and a mage hand from across the room. ... A faux fireplace blazed along one wall, throwing out heat with the single-mindedness of a spell running at full force, yet Sylvira kept shuddering anyway.

subject: Kazryn Nyantani
fact: Kazryn Nyantani is a former romantic partner of Janussi who resented Sylvira for replacing her, and is identified by Sylvira as a suspect with motive rooted in academic jealousy.
source_quote: That bitter old hag... who always resented Janussi for ditching her in favor of me. ... This was my fault.

subject: Daral Yashenti
fact: Daral Yashenti is a drunkard poet who sells his worthless poetry to fund a new library and is dismissed by Sylvira as too inept to have orchestrated Janussi's murder.
source_quote: Daral Yashenti came up first: 'a drunk who is bitter,' having to sell off his worthless poetry to fund a new library. She dismissed him herself before I could. 'He's too much of a drunk to pull off something like that.'

subject: wrapping paper from the poisoned book
fact: The wrapping paper from the poisoned book was transported to the third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers and remained uncollected, serving as the primary physical trail leading to the discovery of Janussi's note.
source_quote: We knew the wrapping paper from the poisoned book had been taken there, and we hadn't gone back. ... There was still the matter of the wrapping paper. The paper that had wrapped the poisoned book had been brought here, and nobody had retrieved it.

subject: note from Janussi
fact: The note from Janussi, found in the third-story apartment, contained a scholarly dismissal of Kalan Strongbranch's criminal investigation methodology as solipsism and revealed Janussi's contempt for the institutionalization of detective work.
source_quote: The opening line landed like a thrown stone. 'Oh boy, this starts out with some real academic insult.' ... Janussi had reviewed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal... found it to be solipsism... as though the investigation of crime were an indulgence, a hobby, a *conceit* Kalan was pursuing for his own entertainment.

subject: Janussi's chambers
fact: Janussi's chambers contained a third-story apartment with unexplored private arrangements, including a note that revealed his intellectual hostility toward Kalan Strongbranch and the institutional rejection of his investigative framework.
source_quote: The third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers was still unvisited. ... I poked around... There was a note. ... Janussi had reviewed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal... and had blocked it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced as absent from Sylvira's interview, presumably preparing to confront Alkrist, and thus not present to provide emotional support during her testimony.
source_quote: Thorin wasn't in the room to offer the easy sympathy. He was off somewhere getting ready to make Alkrist very uncomfortable.

subject: Threefold Proof
fact: The Threefold Proof is Kalan Strongbranch's criminal investigation methodology, formally rejected by Janussi as solipsism, yet still used by Kalan as the operational foundation for the current investigation.
source_quote: Kalan's entire proposal for dealing with crime, the Threefold Proof, the methodologies, the framework we'd been handed as a legitimate investigation tool, had been blocked by the man who was now dead.

subject: Jezebel
fact: Jezebel is Sylvira's familiar, which actively organizes her chamber's seating and performs tasks despite her incapacitated state, indicating her continued agency and control over her environment.
source_quote: 'Jezebel! Organize the chamber's seats in front of me!' The familiar moved with an efficiency that told me this was not the first time Sylvira had directed operations from a sickbed.

subject: Heslin
fact: Brother Heslin is one of the two possible instructors who taught the cohort the art of the urgent errand, though the speaker is uncertain whether it was Heslin or Varath.
source_quote: Brother Heslin, or possibly Brother Varath, I'm genuinely uncertain which, had devoted an entire season to teaching our cohort the art of the urgent errand, the clean dispatch.

subject: Varath
fact: Brother Varath is one of the two possible instructors who taught the cohort the art of the urgent errand, though the speaker is uncertain whether it was Heslin or Varath.
source_quote: Brother Heslin, or possibly Brother Varath, I'm genuinely uncertain which, had devoted an entire season to teaching our cohort the art of the urgent errand, the clean dispatch.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a drow investigator who understands the Menzoberranzan thread in the investigation and uses his cultural awareness to navigate Sylvira’s suspicions and extract truthful testimony.
source_quote: I had recently come up from the Underdark... Born and raised in the Overbright... I'm drow, which was not irrelevant given what we knew about the Menzoberranzan thread running under all of this.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the investigator who failed to flag the feast-burning detail about Alkrist, but later recognized Grygum’s insight as a critical missed observation.
source_quote: I hadn't flagged that one. I had been working through the zone-of-truth timing, the dragonborn opening, when Kalan would arrive. The feast detail had been sitting there, unflagged. Grygum had read it.
